dependency_exceptions.reason: Low-severity prototype poisoning; no patched release exists (4.3.1 is latest). Reached only via @expo/config (build-time config) and jest-config (tests) merging trusted local config; absent from the exported iOS/Android/web bundles (checked 2026-10-28). npm audit's only fix is an Expo/Jest major downgrade, which policy forbids. Owner-approved 2026-10-28; recheck for a patch or upstream replacement before expiry.

Moderate: AbortSignal cancellation bypass allows post-timeout filesystem traversal; fixed only in glob 14.0.2+ (new major, released 2026-10-27/28). Reached only via Jest (@jest/reporters, babel-plugin-istanbul/test-exclude) at test time. No app code imports glob, it is absent from the exported iOS/Android/web bundles, and no caller relies on AbortSignal cancellation for a security boundary. Forcing glob 14 would break the glob 7 callback/sync API Jest uses. Owner-approved 2026-10-31; remove once upstream adopts a patched release.
